_comment: SMART DAK — the L2 layer, and the harness every `smart-*` Digital Adaptation Kit instantiates. Created 2026-09-22 (issue #975) on the owner's stack ruling. It holds the DAK components — personas, business processes, decision logic, data elements — and the authoring transforms over them. DECLARES NO DIRECTORIES, per the `folio-assistant-core` precedent: declaring a directory that is not there is the `dh4f` defect. OPEN, AND NOT DECIDED HERE: `smart-base/tools/` holds nine Tool nodes for the DAK pre/post pipeline, several of which are L2-shaped by the placement question in `smart-stack-layering`. They are there because the owner said so explicitly — 'the skill/tools under smart-base should consolidate under the smart-base/tools/ directory under this repo' — given before this directory existed. Moving them on an inference would override a direct instruction; issue #975 records the question instead.
